| **Willa** | 2018 | Intensified to Cat 4 as it moved across the Pacific near the coast of Baja California; center stayed within 60 NM of the Pacific shore until weakening. |

These four storms are the only Category 4 systems of the 2010–2019 decade that maintained a record‑keeping distance of 60 nautical miles or less from either the west or east coastal boundary of Mexico.
